task.title: Review workbook cli workflow for syncing
task.description:
Workbook commands that create/update tasks should be automatically syncing (fetch/push) as part of that work. A user config could could turn this off globally or at the project level, and a --no-sync flag could turn it off for any given command.
I'm not sure if any of this is already in the app, I don't believe it is but please explore the code as part of this story to evaluate what happens when a task is created/updated.
